breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth corrects the prompt by removing the physically incorrect instruction that bending stress should be treated as uniform. The generated specification failed to identify this as an error and instead repeated the incorrect instruction: 'The pure-bending normal stress is treated as uniform over the section depth...'. It then elaborated on how to apply this faulty logic, directly contradicting the ground truth's approach of removing the error.
